newsitem.title: CHINA: Cheung Kong buys Jardine stake - paper.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong buys Jardine stake - paper.

text.p: Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd and Hutchison Whampoa Ltd together have bought three percent of Jardine Matheson Holdings Ltd and three percent of Hongkong Land Holdings Ltd, a newspaper said.

Jardine Matheson was notified on Monday that the Cheung Kong group held a total of 22.73 million Jardine shares, or 3.03 percent of the company's issued share capital as of August 1, the Hong Kong Economic Journal said on Tuesday.
The group also holds 82.41 million Hongkong Land shares or 3.06 percent of the firm, it quoted Jardine as saying.
Jardine officials were not immediately available for comment.
The Jardine statement did not disclose whether the Cheung Kong group bought the stakes in the market or from a placement, the newspaper said.
Hongkong Land is an affiliate of Jardine Strategic Holdings Ltd which is a subsidiary of the international trading firm Jardine Matheson.
Cheung Kong has nearly a 50 percent stake in Hutchison.
